idea-plugin.name: Redline — Rendered HTML Diff
idea-plugin.description:
Review HTML changes as a rendered document, not markup. When both sides of a diff are HTML, Redline adds a viewer that shows the page as the browser renders it, with insertions and deletions highlighted inline — legal-document style.

Prose edits in long hand-authored lines, renumbered lists, and table changes become readable at a glance instead of a wall of rewrapped markup. Works anywhere the IDE shows a diff: local changes, commits, and VCS revisions.

Select the Redline viewer in the diff editor's view switcher, next to Side-by-side and Unified.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.0 — initial release
  • Redline viewer in the diff editor's view switcher whenever both sides are HTML: one rendered document with deletions struck through and insertions highlighted inline.
  • Works anywhere the IDE shows a diff — Compare Files, Local Changes, commits, and VCS revision history.
  • Previous/next change navigation and a minimap strip marking every change block.
  • Swap Sides action to flip which revision counts as "before".
  • Reviewed documents are rendered sandboxed: scripts never execute and external requests are blocked, so diffing a document can't phone home.
